[b]Hydronian Reelection results - March 2026[/b]

[u]Social Unity Party - WINNERS[/u] (53.5%, 30 governor seats, 200 minister seats)

Hydronian conservative party (10.7%, 6 governor seats, 46 minister seats)

Liberal Party of Hydronia (21.4%, 12 governor seats , 93 minister seats)

Green Future for Hydronia Movement (10.7%, 6 governor seats, 46 minister seats)

Hydronian Preservationists party (3.6%, 2 Governor seats, 15 minister seats)

map: https://i.postimg.cc/x17bKXNT/reelections.png
house of governors: https://i.postimg.cc/D0mCYW57/2025-10-18-15-40-47-987359-24ec7cf7a689f3ca655183b7b2d0823e7a17200a86f10b0cb716a13380b37258.png
house of ministers: https://i.postimg.cc/Qtf4bgQN/2025-10-18-15-46-11-307354-6117d2114dea147c9dc203922d05347d27b5c88d010d785e6dbdff4b6618ccb0.png

[b]The aftermath[/b]

After the elections concluded, the new president of Hydronia, Hakan Bozkhan, would make the decision to form a coalition government with the liberal party of Hydronia. He knew that Hydronia needed political stability now more than ever, so he decided that a coalition was the right step forward.

Additionally, Hakan has swiftly announced his plans for the country during this electoral term. He has announced that the first item om the government's agenda is to resolve the ongoing dispute with the neue republik and it's companies within Hydronia. In the coming weeks, the government is set to engage in a series of talks with the neue republik to amend the issues within the republik-hydronia deal that caused this dispute, as well as negotiating compensation to republik companies for the loss of assets. This will be done via the Joint Trans-Nestor Trade Commission.

The new government has also made it clear that they will opt to engage in more diplomacy outside of THEP to promote world peace. This will begin by allowing sanguinian officials into the country as they requested just before elections began. The government has also stated that talks may occur between Hydronia and Pantagruel, to establish a neutral trade deal. Despite engaging in more diplomacy outside of THEP, the government has also stated that more cooperation will be done within THEP too, with talks to create a THEP passport and airline resuming, along with other ideas that have not been made public yet.

Another key result of this election will be the heavy declassification of files relating to the ongoing arctic investigation alongside Sikirsk. The SUP made very clear pledges prior to the elections that they would publicise the investigation, as they was a major point of discontent with the conservative government. More info on this matter is expected in the coming weeks.
